name: progress-pie
description: Shows a pie of a multi-part job's progress in the status line and on the MCP2221 + HT16K33 LED matrix, including while background work runs.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the progress pie. Off: no progress tool, no status line entry, nothing on the matrix.

binary.title: claudematrix program
binary.description: Name or path of the claudematrix program. A bare name is looked for in Go's install folders (GOBIN, GOPATH/bin, ~/go/bin), then on PATH. Empty turns the matrix off for this plugin.

addr.title: I2C address
addr.description: I2C address of the matrix, 0x70 to 0x77, set with the jumpers on its back (passed to claudematrix as -addr).

progressFile.title: Progress file
progressFile.description: Where progress is written for claudematrix to read. Empty: ~/.claude/progress-pie.
